text:
Elena: quick flag - compact action bar in the dashboard is causing toast overlap and focus clipping on small rows. noticed when density token is set to the tightest value.
Mike: can you repro steps? which breakpoint?
Elena: Dashboard -> Models list, compact rows (34px). trigger copy on an item -> inline toast appears but sits behind the action menu and focus ring is partially hidden. Chrome + Safari.
Tara: probable culprits: action bar uses `position:relative; z-index: 300` and toasts are portaled with `z-index: 250`. also some buttons are aligned via transform which can push the outline outside the container.
Josh: two quick fixes: 1) bring toast portal z-index above modals/actions (`--z-toast: 1100`) 2) avoid transform nudges for alignment and use padding so the focus halo stays inside the element box.
Aria: accessibility notes: focus must be fully visible. If we increase z-index for toasts, confirm the stacking context doesn’t break popovers. Also contextual aria-labels are missing: buttons say `aria-label="copy"` which is ambiguous in a list.
Mike: pragmatic approach: keep portal z-index higher for global toasts, and for actions triggered inside the row show a localized micro-toast positioned absolutely inside the row with `role="status" aria-live="polite"`. that avoids global stacking issues.
Tara: micro-toast implementation details: absolute inside row, pointer-events:none, no focus capture, fade animation, duration 1200ms, visually-hidden contextual text for screen readers (e.g., "Copied model name X id").
Josh: also reduce halo thickness in compact density: map token `--focus-halo-size` per density (compact:2px, default:3px, spacious:4px). sample CSS: `:root { --focus-halo-size: 3px; } .dense { --focus-halo-size: 2px; }` then `button:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 var(--focus-halo-size) var(--color-focus); }`
Elena: testing checklist: keyboard-only traversal, VoiceOver + NVDA checks, visual diff across density tokens, tooltip placement near table edges, and multiple rapid copies to ensure toasts don't queue badly.
Aria: also suggest `aria-label={`Copy ${item.name} id`}` for all copy actions. for long names, keep a shorter label like `Copy model id for <shortName>` to avoid verbosity.
Tara: will open a draft PR for micro-toast + contextual labels + tokenized halo today. will not change global row spacing in this PR.
DesignBot: Created task DS-1155 and draft PR #2460.
Mike: please include before/after screenshots and a short screencap of keyboard flow in the PR.
Josh: i'll update Figma with halo sizes and micro-toast placement.
Elena: thanks team 680. Ping here when PR is ready for review.
